result.reason: The redline appropriately extends the licence to affiliates and contractors and permits transfer to a successor, while preserving the licence’s purpose and scope. However, it does not establish that a subscription licence is terminable only for uncured material breach; merely referring to Section 4 is insufficient without language imposing that limitation. It also does not provide perpetual and irrevocable treatment for any paid-up licence. The successor-transfer right is dependent on an unseen Section 14(h), so compliance with the preferred position cannot be confirmed. The margin comment does not cure these operative deficiencies.
